issues.desc: background.md never explicitly names or defines the term "Mechanism Placement Proof" even though it is the story's central concept (title + every checklist item). Key Insights only implies it via a list of required proof elements (entrypoint, consumer chain, existing mechanisms, authoritative hook, minimal change). Add one sentence in background.md explicitly naming and defining the term for standalone readability.
